name: HVM Co., Ltd.
summary: HVM Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the fabrication of specialized metallic materials. Its comprehensive product line features a variety of alloys, including those made from nickel, titanium, and copper, as well as stainless steel, sputtering targets, and other sophisticated advanced alloys. The firm was established in April 2003 and operates primarily from its headquarters situated in Anyang-si, South Korea.
